NOTE: 1995 net income and earnings per share presented on proforma basis and assume that the company was subject to federal and state income taxes for the periods presented.

The company said it reduced it annual tax rate in the fourth quarter from 39 percent to 37.7 percent as a result of tax planning strategies which have reduced state income taxes payable. The change resulted in an effective rate of 34.9 percent for the fourth quarter.
Average share figures and per share results adjusted for two-for-one stock split paid May 15, 1996.
